title: SimpleAddons
description: Customized day/night cycles for longer days, only one player needs to sleep, PvP control, creeper blast griefing protection, crop trampling protection, and easier crop harvesting.
body:
# 🚀 SimpleAddons > Make your Paper server feel more like your own. **SimpleAddons** is a lightweight, performance-focused Paper plugin that lets you tweak the subtle mechanics your players interact with every day. From slowing down beautiful summer days to automating farming tasks, it brings essential quality-of-life improvements to your server in one single jar. Every feature is engineered optimized, **ensuring zero impact on your server's tick rate.** --- ## ✨ Features ### 🕒 Time & Weather Control * **Custom Day/Night Cycles:** Make days or nights longer or shorter, without affecting redstone or tick rates. * **Smart Sleep System:** Let just *one* player skip the night or speed through boring rainy days or thunderstorms. * **Weather Cleanup:** Automatically clears rain and storms right after a night is skipped. ### 🛡️ World & Grief Protection * **Anti-Creeper Grief:** Stop creepers from destroying your beautiful builds and terrain while keeping their entity damage. * **Crop Protection:** Prevent players and mobs from trampling and destroying farm crops. * **Global PvP Toggle:** Easily enable or disable PvP mechanics dynamically. ### 🌾 Enhanced Farming (QoL) * **Right-Click Harvest:** Harvest and automatically replant mature crops in a single click using a hoe! ### 🌍 Multi-World Support * Give each world its own unique set of rules. Want custom time cycles in the survival world but vanilla rules in the lobby? You can! --- ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions > 💡 **Tip:** You can use either `/simpleaddons` or the shorter alias `/sa` for all commands. * 💻 `/sa help` — Shows grouped help and usage examples. * 📊 `/sa status [world]` — Shows the active duration and all current plugin settings. * ⏳ `/sa setDuration day night [world]` — Sets both day and night durations at the same time. * ☀️ `/sa setDuration day [world]` — Changes only the daytime duration. * 🌙 `/sa setDuration night [world]` — Changes only the nighttime duration. * ❌ `/sa disableDuration [world]` — Disables custom duration and restores vanilla 10-minute cycles. * 🔄 `/sa resetDuration [world]` — Resets duration to plugin defaults (30-min day / 10-min night). * ⚔️ `/sa pvp ` — Enables or disables player-versus-player damage. * 💥 `/sa creeperDestruction ` — Enables or disables creeper block and ground-item destruction. * 🌱 `/sa cropDestruction ` — Enables or disables crop destruction caused by farmland trampling. * 🌾 `/sa hoeHarvest ` — Enables or disables harvesting and automatic replanting with hoes. * ⚙️ `/sa reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration file (`config.yml`). - Admin commands require: `simpleaddons.admin` (Granted to OP by default) - Player commands require: `simpleaddons.use` (Granted to all players by default) --- ## ⚙️ Default Configuration
📄 Click to view the default config.yml ```yaml # SimpleAddons Configuration File version: 1.0 time-control: enabled: true day-duration-minutes: 30 night-duration-minutes: 10 protection: anti-creeper-grief: true prevent-crop-trampling: true global-pvp: true farming: right-click-harvest: true ```
--- ## 📦 Installation 1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the **Versions** tab. 2. Drop it into your Paper server's `plugins` folder. 3. Restart your server. 4. Configure your settings in-game via command or inside `plugins/SimpleAddons/config.yml`. --- ## 💜 Support & Suggest Features If SimpleAddons helped improve your community's experience, consider supporting the development! * **💰 Support & Pitch an Idea:** You can make a donation via [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=TANK86W7A2RBS). **Have a cool feature idea?** Leave a note with your suggestion when donating! I read every single one of them and it's a great way to help shape the future of the plugin. * **💬 Discord Community (Coming Soon):** I am briefly setting up an official Discord server where you will soon be able to hang out, get direct support, and post new ideas. Stay tuned!
